purpose: Parent execution-routing handoff for corrective Scope 7 and Scope 8. Scope 7 mirrors the child migration-067 and local prior-source compatibility contracts. Scope 8 separately owns operator pointer rollback and exceptional restore acceptance. Historical Scope 1 through Scope 6 rows remain preserved.

scopes.scopeName: Causal Synthesis Event Ledger And Replacement Lifecycle

tests.description: After migration 067, execute the exact legacy 064, 065, and 066 attempt and output INSERT shapes. Prove output identity is projected from its run, all legacy causal fields remain null, no legacy event is fabricated, incomplete new linked writes are rejected, and fresh bootstrap remains valid.
Real PostgreSQL rejects event mutation and deletion, and event rows carry no synthesis or source content.
Each trigger's started and terminal events share one run and attempt identity with exactly one terminal result.

tests.testId: daily and weekly scheduler triggers both persist and read back before delivery
tests.description: Both scheduler paths persist cadence payload and complete terminal-event and read-back gates before logging or delivery.

tests.testId: smackerel_compose preserves piped stdin, closes terminal exec stdin, and leaves non-exec behavior and argv unchanged
tests.description: A direct shell canary proves piped stdin reaches docker compose exec, terminal-backed exec receives closed stdin, and non-exec behavior and argv are unchanged; restoring unconditional stdin replacement is the adversarial negative control.
The persistent negative case restores a swallowed terminal-event error and requires trigger failure without delivery or healthy state.
Changed source or policy produces one replacement, supersedes the prior output before insert, and leaves exactly one current output.
Replacement failure rolls back temporary supersession, keeps the prior current output, and appends safe failure history.
Concurrent same-source and changed-source triggers serialize by actor, cadence, and window while retaining complete event chains and one current output.
Adversarial interleaving proves actor, cadence, run, attempt, and output links cannot cross-pair.
Missing, empty, zero, negative, malformed, and unknown actor, retry, lease, policy, source-class, and retention values fail loudly.
Distinct configured actor, retry, lease, policy, source-class, and retention values reach both cadence paths.
A forced aggregate-read failure appends readback_failed, and a later coherent read appends recovered without erasing failure history.

tests.testId: committed-unverified state survives restart and recovery appends after verified read-back
tests.description: A real core restart preserves the readback_failed event and latest/history/detail API refusal. A later coherent read appends recovered. Strict health is certified only by T004-C20-STRICT in Scope 8.

tests.testId: prior-source lifecycle pins the full SHA, forbids fetch, records digest and inputs, owns unique refs, registers lifecycle required, and cleans every resource
tests.description: Static contract enforces full SHA 7c3838e3b2de9ecba2e6a7764493a0412c4ed268, a local-object precondition, no fetch command, detached old-revision CLI build, final digest and resolved-input recording, runtime-network denial, lifecycle/required registration, unique resource references, and cleanup traps.

tests.testId: pinned local prior source and current candidate preserve migration 067 without fabricated causal history
tests.description: Required lifecycle test builds the exact local prior source in a detached worktree through its own CLI, records final image digest and build inputs, denies runtime network, boots against disposable PostgreSQL through 067, verifies authenticated liveness/read and daily plus weekly write-or-fail-closed behavior with zero fabricated causal events, switches to the current candidate for retained-067 and strict causal-write proof, and cleans every owned resource.

tests.testId: full synthesis API restart state-matrix scheduler prior-source lifecycle and event-failure suite
tests.description: Historical and corrective synthesis journeys, including the required prior-source lifecycle, run together with no required skip or first-party interception.

scopes.scopeName: Causal Synthesis Health, Recovery, And Deployment Acceptance

tests.description: Supporting integration proves the snapshot query selects latest attempt and output from one configured actor/cadence causal history.

tests.testId: running core causal snapshots never cross-pair actors or cadences
tests.description: The running core receives interleaved principals, daily/weekly cadences, attempts, outputs, and timestamps over real HTTP. The two-global-query implementation produces a forbidden cross-pair; one actor/cadence snapshot remains causal.
Running, failed, and recovered states follow same-actor/cadence event order while historical failure remains queryable.

tests.testId: running core synthesis state remains non-green until verified persisted recovery
tests.description: The running core API and scraped synthesis state remain non-green through request, running, committed-unverified, and failed states, then change only after production aggregate read-back verifies a later persisted recovery. This does not claim Alertmanager fired.

Static parsing proves the four production synthesis alerts consume canonical state with configured for-windows 30m, 1h, 24h, and 15m. No test sleeps through those windows or claims unobserved Alertmanager firing.
Startup appends typed non-green facts for expired running and committed-unverified rows without fabricating success.

tests.testId: running core reconciles both cadences before router readiness and scheduler admission after restart
tests.description: Seed expired-running daily and committed-unverified weekly state, restart the real core, and prove both ReconcileStartup calls finish before router/readiness/scheduler admission. Abandoned work stays non-green until a later verified attempt.
Missing, zero, negative, and invalid daily/weekly freshness values fail loudly; valid distinct values parse.
Preserve generated-config loading and static consumer-token coverage as supporting evidence. This row does not prove running API, web, health, or metrics behavior.

tests.testId: running core applies distinct daily and weekly freshness to API web health and metrics
tests.description: Boot the running core with deliberately distinct daily and weekly freshness values and prove their different behavior through latest API responses, Today, Status, strict health, and scraped metrics.
No hardcoded synthesis freshness constant or alias to the digest freshness setting remains in production consumers.
Preserve the in-process HTTP matrix as supporting integration evidence. Because it uses httptest rather than the running core process, it cannot satisfy live E2E.

tests.testId: running core strict health refuses every non-green required cadence and recovers only after verified read-back
tests.description: Issue HTTP requests to the running core for required-cadence never-run, running, stale, partial, failed, and read-degraded states, then prove failed-to-verified-recovery before strict health becomes green.

tests.testId: candidate is refused while intelligence is down and accepted only after verified recovery
tests.description: The normal zero-manual deploy refuses non-green intelligence and accepts the candidate only after a new verified recovery.

tests.testId: prior release pointer rollback restores service and retained event history remains queryable
tests.description: The normal rollback restores the accepted prior release without deleting the candidate event history.

tests.testId: Today and Status report the same durable synthesis state
tests.description: The production Today and Status routes expose the same durable state and preserve privacy clearing and state exclusivity.

tests.testId: real synthesis action buttons are 44 by 44 and Retry click round-trips through the running core
tests.description: Measure real visible actionable controls at 44 by 44 CSS pixels or larger. Click the real Retry control, observe lifecycle feedback, and verify the persisted result after reload. Noninteractive labels are excluded; synthetic controls and page.request mutations do not satisfy this row.

tests.testId: Today and Status reflow at actual browser 200% zoom without overlap or horizontal scroll
tests.description: Observe browser page scale 2.0 on both production routes and assert no overlap, clipping, hidden action, or horizontal document scroll. Reduced viewport width alone is not accepted as zoom proof.
Concurrent running-core daily and weekly snapshots preserve actor/cadence causality and record p99 latency at or below the existing core.health 200ms target.

Metrics and public/denied responses expose no principal, run, source, content, or high-cardinality identifiers. Traces may carry only opaque run_id plus safe bounded fields; logs may carry only design-required bounded run identity. No surface carries text, source IDs/titles, fingerprints, raw errors, SQL, or credentials.

tests.testId: synthesis.health-recovery contains startup reconcile read snapshot and health aggregate spans
tests.description: With validate-plane OTel enabled, capture both startup cadence spans, per-cadence read snapshots, and the health aggregate. Complete the 3 AM, error, >=200ms latency, retry, fan-out, and missing-span/attribute scan. The thin core.health trace cannot satisfy this row.

tests.testId: core.health remains at p99 <= 200ms during mixed-cadence synthesis reads
tests.description: Capture 600 requests at concurrency 20 and require p99 <= 200ms, error <= 0.1%, and availability >= 99.9% using the registered core.health contract.
tests.command: bash scripts/observability/capture-slo.sh run --workflow core.health --url http://127.0.0.1:45001/api/health --requests 600 --concurrency 20 --source stress

tests.testId: full synthesis API restart state-matrix strict-readiness and recovery suite
tests.description: The broad local API suite passes with zero required skips or internal interception. It makes no browser or Playwright claim.

tests.testId: full synthesis Today and Status Playwright suite
tests.description: The separate broad local Playwright suite passes with zero required skips or first-party interception before deployment approval.
